title: Add admin panel and role-based workflows (Owner / Editor / Organizer)
body:
Build a web admin UI and server-side RBAC to manage events, participants, certificates, and roles (Owner / Editor / Organizer).

- Add a web admin interface to manage events and participants.
- Implement role-based permissions to allow Owners/Editors/Organizers to approve/edit events, manage participants, upload certificates, and assign winners.
- Backend changes: roles/permissions model, endpoints to CRUD roles, and enforcement on event/participant endpoints.
- Frontend changes: admin listing for pending events, event edit UI, role assignment UI, audit logs.

Acceptance criteria: Admin UI reachable at /admin, RBAC enforcement server-side, tests and README updates.

title: Add OpenAPI spec and Redoc UI for backend API
body:
Generate and serve an OpenAPI (Swagger) schema for public and admin APIs and expose Redoc (or Swagger UI) at /api/docs.

- Produce an OpenAPI schema that documents endpoints for events, participants, users, admin workflows.
- Serve an interactive docs UI (Redoc or Swagger UI) at /api/docs or /documentation.
- Add CI check to ensure schema is updated with API changes.
- Document how to generate/update the schema locally.

Acceptance criteria: /api/docs serves interactive docs; CI enforces schema generation; README updated.

title: Add server-side email templating and scheduled event reminders
body:
Add templated email support for reminders, confirmations, and organizer notifications and implement scheduled reminders.

- Add email templates for event reminders, registration confirmations, and organizer notices (repo-stored or DB-backed editable templates).
- Provide admin/dev preview for templates.
- Implement scheduled reminder delivery (e.g., via Celery/RQ/cron worker) that sends reminders X hours before events.
- Add tests and developer docs for template editing and scheduler configuration.

Acceptance criteria: Templates exist and can be previewed/sent; scheduled reminders enqueue and send test emails; docs added.

title: Add search, bookmark/save, and subscription UX for event discovery
body:
Add full-text search, bookmark/save functionality, and subscription preferences so users can discover and follow events and organizers.

- Implement search endpoints (full-text search over titles/descriptions, tag filters).
- Add bookmark/save endpoints and UI so users can save events.
- Add subscription preferences to follow organizers or categories and trigger notifications (push/email).
- Frontend changes: search box, filters, bookmark button, subscription controls in settings.

Acceptance criteria: Search endpoint supports queries and filters; users can bookmark; subscription preferences trigger notifications; basic tests added.
